criteria.description: The user can obtain a compiled specification through the real CLI/API (daemon-mediated forge spec save / POST /tasks/{id}/specification/compile + GET /tasks/{id}/specification + forge spec show).
The compiled result survives a daemon restart (objective, AC IDs, version, lock state, and lock provenance byte-identical after stop/start).
A repeat compile/save request is idempotent (same version, Created=false, no new audit event, no duplicate version); concurrent identical compiles mint exactly one version.

Black-box evidence is required (unit-only wiring is insufficient): the create -> compile -> show -> lock -> restart -> show lifecycle is proven through the compiled forge binary against an isolated NEUROFORGE_HOME.

blackbox.scenario: forge daemon start -> forge project add (real git repo) -> forge task add -> forge spec save (version 1, Created=true, objective + AC-1 + R1/C1) -> forge spec show (same persisted spec) -> forge spec save again (Created=false, idempotent) -> forge spec lock -v 1 --by alice (locked=true) -> forge spec versions ([1]) -> forge daemon stop -> forge daemon start -> forge spec show (version 1, same objective, AC-1, locked=true, locked_by=alice; provenance survives restart) -> forge spec save after restart (Created=false, version 1) -> 20 concurrent forge spec save -> forge spec versions still [1]. Driven through the compiled /tmp/forge-m14-03-accept binary in an isolated temp HOME.

remediation_note: Remediation performed by M14-03-remediation-session on original candidate 78d1ff1, addressing MAJOR-1 (TOCTOU concurrency: moved compare-and-mint into task.SpecificationStore.SaveIfChanged serialised by a per-task keyed mutex; compile runs outside the lock; dead 'differs -> replace in place' branch removed) and MAJOR-2 (moved specificationsSemanticallyEqual to the task package with a 30-case table test; deleted the unreachable 'replace in place' branch; honest 'differs -> new version' fallback directly exercised). Re-reviewed by M14-03-rereview-session on remediated candidate a9869f9 (verdict REVIEW_APPROVED). Three non-blocking MINOR findings accepted as follow-ups: MINOR-1 (unnecessary defensive sleep in audit-count test, masks nothing), MINOR-2 (spec show error wording for missing task, pre-existing FU-M14-03-4), MINOR-3 (latent compileLocks.release double-release guard, unreachable by any current caller).

minor_summary: MINOR-1: unnecessary defensive time.Sleep in TestSpecAdapter_ConcurrentIdempotentReuseAudit (masks nothing; transactional audit write is verified)
MINOR-2 (FU-M14-03-4): spec show on a missing task returns 'specification not found' rather than 'task not found' (pre-existing; both HTTP 404; CLI contract holds)
MINOR-3: compileLocks.release would panic on a double-release (latent; not reachable by any current caller)
